notes.title: The Party Finder is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello to the entire community!

[h2][b]We are excited to announce that we have integrated a "party finder" tool into the game! From now on, you can easily find opponents to challenge![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741266/4166ee3be434405ccc5ccdff2b91afce8207b090.png[/img]

Based on your feedback regarding the difficulty of finding opponents, we sought the best way to connect players with each other. While a Discord server was launched, we decided to further enhance the experience for everyone by integrating a new tool directly into the game.

We hope you enjoy this feature!

See you in the arena!

The Development Team

[b]Follow us on our social media:[/b]

X : https://twitter.com/DoryahGames

Youtube : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkLKhaH9aeb39vnUu-ItqLQ

Tiktok : https://www.tiktok.com/@doryah_games

notes.title: KROSFIGHTER X VIRGIL AUGEN : A POWERFUL ALLIANCE !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741266/cce321b4518c35b5abb2109ef71ff63078c22ba4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Such a hard-hitting alliance deserves an in-game skin, don't ya think?[/h2]

Krosfighter is no rookie, but this'll really knock you out!

A gem from the world of MMA just entered the ring of the party game devoted to brawling!

At just over 6'1" tall and a mere 25 years old, Virgil Augen is an undefeated young champion with a promising career. Since he's a huge fan of the DOFUS MMO and the Ankamaverse in general, he naturally agreed to this explosive collab.

Wish you could be this unparalleled fighter? Now you can, after a fashion… In honor of the occasion, we're giving everyone a Virgil Augen skin that can be used in the game Krosfighter (on the character Joe)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741266/20c8cd749baf602830dfda29b1c096e9ad949112.png[/img]

Krosfighter hit hard…
And Virgil Augen hit back!

[h2]NEW: PARTY FINDER[/h2]

There's no shortage of brawls in Krosfighter… And with a new feature coming soon, you'll be able to crash any fight you want! Use your expertise to help other players, and enhance your fighting skills!

So many rings, so many chances… to knock everyone out!
